[SWS_DM_02140] Reporting "DoIP diagnostic message check failed" to IdsM
Upstream requirements:
RS_Ids_00810
⌈
If a DoIP diagnostic message is rejected and leads to a "diagnostic mes-
sage negative acknowledgment", the DM shall report a security event
SEV_DOIP_DIAG_MESSAGE_CHECK_FAILED to IdsM (see [26] and table
[SWS_DM_02141]) with the context data given in [SWS_DM_02141].
⌋
The DoIP diagnostic message check is described in ISO 13400-2 in the figure "DoIP
diagnostic message handler".
[SWS_DM_02141] Security event context data definition: SEV_DOIP_DIAG_MES-
SAGE_CHECK_FAILED
